I couldn't set up the 09:00 digest, so nothing will arrive tomorrow.

The scheduler refused to create the job because the Gateway has no credentials configured for it. My attempt to get that fixed through the OpenClaw admin tool also failed, because the AI service sign-in is broken.

I did two things that are ready for when it's fixed:
- I confirmed you're a member of #coastal-team.
- I saved a starting point to `/workspace/digests/coastal-team-digest-state.json`, so the first digest would only cover posts after 9:00 today and not repeat older ones.

To get the digest running, someone with Gateway admin access needs to set up the Gateway credentials and the OpenClaw sign-in. Then ask me again and I'll create the daily job for 09:00 Chicago time. Until then, I can post a digest of #coastal-team here whenever you ask. It will leave out money terms like rates, prices, contract values, invoices and payment terms, and point you to the channel for those.
